answer: Tie voting weight to bonded stake that unlocks only after a slow tide of epochs, and slash it when an account's grades correlate too tightly with a cluster it keeps endorsing. Keep an atlas of who-grades-whom; a sybil ring shows up as a dense island that mostly rates itself. Even if its members only whisper to each other off-chain, the correlated scores give them away, and each new fake identity must lock fresh capital it risks losing.
